title: Why AI Cheating is Serious Business

scenes.text: AI has prompted drastic changes in how we assess student performance.
Recent studies show scores dropped significantly when professors required in-person finals.
This highlights growing concerns over the impact of AI on academic integrity.
Academic challenges are evolving due to technology.
scenes.label: STAY AHEAD

scenes.text: Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: The rise of AI in education is changing how students are assessed. Follow for daily tech!
